experiment: Balanced-β intervention on gap-induced RAdam divergence
task: P0: does balancing beta1=beta2 reduce the gap-induced R_opt?

protocol.gradient_sequence: Same real paired {G_t^1.0, G_t^1.3}_{t=1..20} from the frozen #49 Arm-A checkpoints (k32/k64/k128/k256, same seed-3 trajectory)
protocol.starting_point: UNIFORM for all beta configs: m0=0, v0=0, step0=0. The real extracted state is never used (no old-beta history + new-beta step mixing).
protocol.effective_support: top 1% of coords by |u1| (np.partition quantile mask); R_opt over full vector (scale-invariant)

validation.replay: pure-numpy float32 RAdam (analysis/numpy_radam.py), validated against stored torch-generated histories to ~1 ulp (cross-K verify_u1_final)
validation.synthetic_smoke: local synthetic near-scalar test passed before server run
